rollback.inverse.restore_file: Restore the deleted file (pre-state taken from this system's undo journal)
rollback.inverse.revoke_message: Register the message recall (external inboxes are outside this system's control)
rollback.inverse.cancel_booking: Cancel the booking / order (the cancel is a new compensation record)
rollback.inverse.undo_write: Record-level compensation: only the write inside this system is undone; tokens already spent and content already generated or sent cannot be recalled, and the page never says the generated result was recalled
rollback.inverse.noop_read: Read-only action: no external side effect, nothing to undo
rollback.inverse.irreversible_financial: Money transfer is irreversible: the funds left the account boundary this system governs and there is no unilateral reversal channel; run the manual reversal through the payment / banking channel and append a compensation record (never claim this step was undone)
rollback.inverse.irreversible_contract: Signature is irreversible: the signed text already reached the counterparty and the evidence store, so this system cannot withdraw the signature; run the rescission / voiding / addendum process and append a compensation record (never claim the signature was undone)
rollback.inverse.escalate_financial_reversal: Escalate to a manual payment reversal: this system does not reverse the transfer, it only records the escalation request and the compensation record
rollback.inverse.escalate_contract_rescission: Escalate to a contract rescission / voiding process: this system does not withdraw the signature, it only records the escalation request and the compensation record
rollback.error.rollback_not_reversible: That action has no registered inverse operation, so it cannot be rolled back (ROLLBACK_NOT_REVERSIBLE).
rollback.error.rollback_dependents_pending: Later actions depend on this one; confirm them together (confirm_all=true) or roll them back first (ROLLBACK_DEPENDENTS_PENDING).
rollback.error.rollback_already_rolled_back: That action was already rolled back (ROLLBACK_ALREADY_ROLLED_BACK).
rollback.error.rollback_inverse_failed: The inverse operation failed; the journal records what was attempted (ROLLBACK_INVERSE_FAILED).
rollback.error.rollback_field_invalid: A rollback field is missing or has the wrong type (ROLLBACK_FIELD_INVALID).
rollback.error.rollback_dependents_irreversible: Dependent steps in the closure have no inverse operation; only the reversible members can be rolled back, and confirm_all=true rolls just those (ROLLBACK_DEPENDENTS_IRREVERSIBLE).
rollback.error.rollback_journal_unreadable: The undo journal cannot be read, so rollback state is unknown; nothing was planned or executed (ROLLBACK_JOURNAL_UNREADABLE).
rollback.error.rollback_idempotency_mismatch: That idempotency key was already used for a different action_id (ROLLBACK_IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH).
